entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes... I feel like I can play shogi[n]at a different pace here.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The scenery, the sounds, the smells...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'll be able to utilize all five of my[n]senses... Perhaps I'll even come up[n]with some new ideas.
You use your senses in shogi?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A change in sensibility changes one's[n]choice of moves. It may help you to[n]improve as well.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes, a different sensibility than usual[n]awakens. It helps one come up with[n]new moves.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Indeed. Shogi isn't only about using[n]one's brains.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You must use your senses to identify[n]all possibilities,  including your best[n]moves.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I've opened up new opportunities[n]through shogi.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You are like a shogi piece filled with[n]endless moves...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I wonder what kind of person you[n]will become... Just imagining all the[n]possibilities is fun.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: *giggle* I'm starting to get the feeling[n]that a new move will come to me.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well then, now that we feel refreshed...[n]let us play, fair and square!
